exercises.why: **Зайди** — зайти́ (perfective): to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch; (nautical) to call at, to enter (a port); (nautical) to get, to advance. Wiktionary: за- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.
